results.title: Ex-Rangers coach dismisses Covid 'advantage' during lockdown league win
results.description: Former Rangers boss Gerrard has "no regrets" about joining Aston Villa, according to his former assistant McAllister.

results.title: India to don saffron WC jersey; Viren Rasquinha questions logic
results.description: New Delhi: The Indian men’s and women’s hockey teams will be seen in saffron jerseys instead of their traditional blue kits at next month’s FIH World Cup in the Netherlands and Belgium, a change that has been questioned by former captain Viren Rasquinha. Unveiling the new jersey on its social media pages, Hockey India said [...]
